newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chuo Paperboard ask-only in morning.
newsitem.headline: Chuo Paperboard ask-only in morning.

text.p: Shares in Chuo Paperboard Co Ltd were ask only in early morning trade on Monday after the firm said on Friday that it plans to set aside loan loss reserves of 12.42 billion yen for the first half of the 1996/97 business year, brokers brokers said.
As of 0026 GMT, the shares were ask-only at 395 yen after closing at 405 yen on Friday.
The company forgave the same amount of loans to its affiliate Nippon Pack Co Ltd at the end of the half-year, which was September 30, a company spokesman said Friday.
